chunks: And indeed, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, walked behind the funeral of a man from the Ansar. Then it was said to him, "Will you not ride, O Messenger of Allah?" So he said, "Indeed, I dislike to ride while the angels are walking."

key_terms.أَرْكَبَ: To ride, meaning to mount an animal instead of walking
key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: The Ansar, the Helpers of Madinah
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: The angels, whose walking is mentioned as the reason for refraining from riding
key_terms.جَنَازَةِ: A funeral procession or bier of the deceased
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the one whose conduct is being described

ai.seo_question: Why did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم refuse to ride during a funeral procession?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم walking behind a funeral procession and declining to ride out of reverence while the angels were walking. It reflects prophetic humility, proper etiquette toward funerals, and awareness of the unseen presence surrounding acts connected to death.
